text.content:
The reporter who proved Militech nuked Night City.

Role: Media
Affiliation: Leak News, his independent outfit
Known for: The Night City Holocaust exposé (2045, re-released 2047)

In 2045 Santiago put out the story of his career: the 2023 bomb in Arasaka Tower, the Night City Holocaust, was Militech's. He had a nomad eyewitness from the raid team inside the tower, who saw the team's leader walk off down a stairwell with a heavy suitcase a minute or two before the tower went up; radiation trails; an Arasaka source; and people who had been in the rubble. Nobody believed it.

After Static Night dragged the rogue Militech cell into daylight, he re-released the exposé that October with new sources and names, and this time it stuck. It brought down Senator Marcus Armstrong in 2048, and led to the hearings that ended with President Kress stepping down in 2053. He won't name his Arasaka source; asked, he sings the Puma Squad theme song.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 05
